topic: Reselling: your teen turning $20 into $200 — and learning how business actually works
caption:
Your teen turned $20 into $200 this weekend — and learned how business actually works.
Thrift stores and garage sales are full of items people sell for a dollar that others will pay $20 for online.
HustleUp walks your teen through finding, pricing, and listing their first item step by step.
